title: Immunoprecipitation \(IP) of Homer 1a, injection of virions and in situ hybridization in the spinal cord
protocol: Kill mice with an overdose of ether.
Perform a spinal laminectomy, isolating the L4-L5 segments.
Rapidly homogenize isolated segments in hypotonic buffer containing protease inhibitors.
Lyse samples for 30 min in ice-cold 2x RIPA buffer.
Centrifuge lysates for 10 min at 4°C to remove insoluble material.
Incubate cleared protein lysates with protein A-/G-plus Sepharose beads for 1 h.
Separate beads and incubate supernatant with Homer1a-specific antibody overnight.
Incubate the antibody-bound complex with protein A-/G-plus Sepharose beads for 2 h at 4°C.
Wash beads twice with RIPA buffer.
Wash beads twice with PBS.
Resuspend precipitated proteins in 2x SDS sample buffer and boil for 3 min.
Load boiled samples on SDS-polyacrylamide gel.
Anaesthetize adult mice with Fentanyl: Domitor: Dormicum (4:6:16; 0.7 μl/g; i.p.)
Incise the skin overlying lower thoracic and lumbar vertebrae.
Perform a laminectomy at the L3-L5 level.
Open the spinal dura.
Immobilize the mouse on a glass-plate.
Fill the Hamilton-syringe with a gas-tight luer tip connected to a glass capillary of defined tip diameter 60 μm.
Mix AAV-viral stocks with 20% Mannitol in a ratio 2:1.
Back fill the syringe with water and separate from the soaked viral injection solution by a small air bubble.
Connect the syringe to a nanoliter injector and an Ultramicro pump.
Penetrate the injection capillary at an angle of 45° into the dorsal horn of the spinal cord around 80 μm deep.
Infuse 300 nl mixture containing around 1.2x10^7 virions bilaterally, twice on each side.
Place Gelfoam directly on the spinal cord and muscles.
Suture the skin.
Allow mice to recover for 2-3 weeks before behavioral testing.
Inject AAV-EGFP virions in the spinal dorsal horn of mice.
Perform pathological examination of the spinal cord at 2 weeks after the injection.
Clone PCR-Products of the probe templates directly into the Zero Blunt end TOPO vector according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Determine the orientation of probe insertion by Sequencing.
Linearize clones and purify the linearized plasmid DNA
In vitro transcribe 1 μg DNA with 20 U of the appropriate RNA polymerase, 10 mM DTT, 1 U/μl RNAsin and DIG RNA Labeling mix in a total volume of 20 μl in transcription buffer for 2 h at 37°C.
Add 1 U/μl RNase-free DNase I to stop the reaction for 15 min at 37°C and then add 25 mM EDTA.
Hydrolyze cRNA probes according to the formula t = (Ls - Le) / (K * Ls * Le).
Induce hydrolysis by adding 0.1M NaOH in a final volume of 200 μl on ice.
Stop the reaction with 200 μl of 0.1 M hydrochloric acid.
Precipitate and redissolve riboprobes in 50 μl TE buffer with a final concentration of 1 U/μl RNase inhibitor.
Use five μl (around 500ng) for analysis, and store the residual volume in aliquots at -20°C.
Block for 30 minutes in Blocking solution in Maleic Acid buffer.
Incubate with anti-DIG-AP-Fab solution (Roche) in dilution buffer for 10 minutes.
Wash two times for 15 minutes each.
Equilibrate the membrane for 5 minutes in Detection buffer.
Perform color development in Detection buffer containing NBT/BCIP (0.02%) in the dark.
Stop the reaction by transferring the blot in TE buffer.
Freeze tissues on dry ice and maintain at -70°C.
Prewarm for 30 minutes at minus 20°C, cut tissue using a Cryostat (Leica), mount on Poly-L-lysine-coated glass slides, and air-dry for 30-60 minutes.
Fix sections by incubating in 4% PFA for 5 minutes before washing three times for 5 minutes each in PBS.
Incubate slides with 0.2% TritonX-100 followed by 5-minute washing with PBS.
Incubate with 1 μg/ml Proteinase K in TE for 15 minutes at 37°C.
Treat sections for 1 minute with 0.1 M Glycine in PBS, 5 minutes with 4% PFA and twice for 5 minutes each with PBS.
Incubate sections in TAE (40mM Tris-HCl, pH 8, 20mM acetic acid, 2mM EDTA, pH 8.0), followed by treatment with 0.25% Acetic anhydride in TAE for 10 minutes.
Wash sections three times for 5 minutes each with PBS.
Perform pre-hybridization for 3-4 hours in a hybridization chamber which is humidified with 5x SSC/50% Formamide.

Dilute sense and antisense DIG-labelled cRNA probes in hybridization buffer consisting of 50% formamide, 2% blocking reagent (Roche), 5x SSC, 0.02% SDS, and 0.1% Laurylsarcosine to a concentration of 1:20-1:120.
Hybridize with the diluted probes overnight at 65°C.
Wash sections twice for 10 min each in 2x SSC buffer.
Treat sections with Ribonuclease A (50 μg) in buffer consisting of 10 mM Tris-HCl, 1 mM EDTA, and 500 mM NaCl at pH 8.0 for 30 min at 37°C.
Wash sections at 65°C for 10 min in 0.2x SSC buffer.
Wash sections at room temperature for 5 min in 0.2x SSC buffer.
Incubate sections in Maleic acid buffer (0.1 M maleic-acid pH 7.5, 0.15 M NaCl) for 5 min.
Incubate slides in 1% blocking reagent in Maleic acid buffer for 1 hour.
Incubate slides in Anti-DIG-AP-Fab fragment (Roche; 1:1800) in Maleic acid buffer containing 1% blocking reagent for 1 hour.
Wash slides twice for 30 min each in Maleic acid buffer.
Equilibrate slides in Detection buffer (100 mM Tris-HCl pH 9.5, 100 mM NaCl, 50 mM MgCl2).
Detect using NBT/BCIP (0.02%) in Detection buffer in the dark.
Stop reaction by adding TE buffer and washing sections several times in distilled water.
Mount sections with Mowiol and store at 4°C.
